points.description: States the core idea: elements are taken one at a time and each is inserted into its correct position among the already sorted elements (the sorted part, on its left).
points.partial_credit: Award 2-3 marks if the answer only says it inserts or places elements in the right position, or only says it builds a sorted portion, without linking the two.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating, in any wording, that each element in turn is inserted into its correct place within the already sorted part of the array. Brief or informal answers are fine, and 'left to right' or exact terms are not required. Part marks for a vague or half-correct idea, such as only 'inserts in the right position' or 'builds a sorted section'. No marks for answers describing other sorts, such as repeated swapping of neighbours or finding the minimum.
